text:
Maya: Heads up — launch week social plan for the Optimize feature. Need an X thread, LinkedIn post, and a couple quick assets. Target: Tue webinar 10am PT + benchmark thread Wed. Who owns copy + scheduling? :rocket:

Jordan: I can take X thread + LinkedIn headline. First pass by EOD.

Sam: I’ll produce 3 image cards, hero banner, and a GIF. Need final copy and sizes. PNG + Figma source ok?

Maya: Figma: https://figma.com/file/optimize-launch (internal). Sizes: X card 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x628, thread 800x800, GIF ~600px width. Also need 16:9 hero for webinar page.

Ravi: Scheduling recs: X thread start Tue 09:30 PT, second tweet 12:00 PT, webinar reminder 1h before. LinkedIn primary post Tue 10:00 PT. I'll handle timezone notes for EMEA/APAC.

Ellie: I can queue in Hootsuite. Need final copy + assets by Tue 08:30 PT to avoid last-minute issues. Tone: technical with product impact — confirm?

Hannah: Inbound routing: use UTM campaign=optimize_launch, source=social. Map signups to SFDC queue "Marketing - Launch" and ping #sdr-inbound. Webhook to post lead details to #sales-inbound.

Sam: ETA assets Mon 6pm PT. Will upload PNGs/GIF named: optimize_x_card.png, optimize_linkedin.png, optimize_thread_1.png, optimize_gif.gif to Drive: https://drive.redwood/optimize-launch/assets

Jordan: Can we use stat "2.3x lower latency at 50-token median" in copy? @Maya

Maya: Yes — use "up to 2.3x lower latency" and link to benchmark blog. Avoid absolute claims.

Jordan: Draft X thread:
Tweet 1: "New: Optimize — serve models with up to 2.3x lower latency for production apps and smarter batching. #LLMops #inference"
Tweet 2: "How we did it: smarter batching, KV cache-aware routing, hardware-aware kernels. TL;DR + blog -> https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize"
Tweet 3: "Demo + live Q&A: Tue 10am PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social"
Tweet 4: "Want a quick cost/latency estimate for your workload? Reply with model & tokens and we'll run a spot-check."

Jordan: LinkedIn draft: "Announcing Optimize — a production-focused inference toolkit that reduces latency and cost for real-world LLM workloads. Join our webinar Tue 10am PT for demo + benchmarks. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social"

Ellie: Add a pinned reply to the X thread with registration + replay once available. Also pin LinkedIn post on company page.

Hannah: Follow-up flow: auto thank-you email with recording + CTA to book a demo. SDRs get leads with lead_score >=50. Create manual task for PoC requests.

Maya: @Hannah align with SalesOps on SFDC queue + Slack notif by EOD. Ensure UTM fields land in lead records.

Hannah: Will open ticket and cc @Maya. Proposed Slack notif:
ops-bot: "New Optimize lead: <name> — score: <score> — email: <email> — reg: utm_campaign=optimize_launch. Follow-up owner: @oncall-sdr"

Sam: Assets uploaded to Drive and Figma updated.

Ellie: Drafts queued in Hootsuite "Drafts" folder. Will publish once Maya gives greenlight. Scheduling: threaded publish (tweet1->tweet4).

Jordan: Edit: add "for production apps" to tweet1. Done.

Maya: Include a short customer quote on the hero card. Jordan provided: "Cut tail latency and lowered cost per request." Approved.

Ellie: Engagement play: 1) reply from social account within 2 hours for top mentions, 2) manual outreach for demo requests within 24 hours. I'll add to Hootsuite notes.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Webinar registration closes Tue 9:00 AM PT.

Maya: Plan: Jordan final copy by EOD, Sam assets Mon 6pm, Ellie queues Tue 08:30. @Hannah coordinate SFDC/Webhook with SalesOps. I’ll post final sign-off when green. :white_check_mark:

Ellie: Also recommend a post-launch engagement sweep 48 hours after publish to surface top replies for SDRs.
